notes.title: We are Back
notes.notes:
New titles in the works and a complete Catalog sale. 

Hey Guys, 

It has been a while but we are back. 

With two titles in the works and a potential third, we are making another run to bring you sequels to the silly games which we all grew to love. 

There's Poop in my Soup 2 - in the works
Frisky Business 2 - in the works


This week we will be running a sale on the whole catalog, check it out below and pick up a game or two if they are missing from your K Bros catalog, there is something for everyone. 

Classics like There's Poop in my Soup, Super Duper Party pooper or Flix and Chill are always a laugh with friends. Albert and Otto was our first game and still very close to our hearts, if you have Albert and Otto then definitely check out Burn it Down as they are very similar yet so different. Tanks vs Aliens and Evil Glitch are awesome for blowing off some steam. 


I have linked all the pages below so you can check them out. 

Thanks for all your support, we look forward to bringing you more games! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/485870/Super_Duper_Party_Pooper/

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update (TRADING CARDS)
notes.notes:
[h1]TRADING CARDS and Update v1.4[/h1]

Excited to announce that the trading cards have been approved and are finally here! 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/TradingCards_SteamImage.png[/img]

There are also cool sets of badges and emoticons to unlock along with the Trading card drops.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/BadgesSteam.png[/img]

And of course I just couldn't resist putting a few more little details into the game itself. 

[h1]Additions: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]A more robust xinput controller support implemented
    [*]Added extra art assets to the end scene
    [*]Added an "Are you sure?" screen to new game option, ensuring that save files do not get wiped by accident.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed visual glitch that caused a box to flash at the stream area
    [*]Fixed death counter bug that caused it to sometimes give the wrong death count.
[/list]

As always thank you for your support and I hope you have a great weekend.

Feel free to follow me on twitter [url=twitter.com/nikmakesgames] @nikmakesgames[/url]

Nik

notes.title: Review Round-Up #2 and Let's Plays!
notes.notes:
Albert & Otto's on the move! We've got more reviews and some wonderful Lets Plays on YouTube to share today.

But before we get into that, have any burning questions for us? We're doing an AMA on Reddit! If you've got questions on game development, the future of Albert & Otto, what exactly Albert's secret is, or anything at all, hop on over and ask! Or float us an upvote, won't you?

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA/comments/3v2toj/iama_solo_indie_dev_who_taught_myself_to_code/][img=https://www.redditstatic.com/about/assets/reddit-logo.png][/img]Ask Me Anything on Reddit[/url]

Onto the reviews and Youtube vids!

Let's Play: MrKravin tries to figure out if he's getting dumber or if the puzzles are getting harder!
https://youtu.be/x9DQ5ciyKsw

Let's Play: The Gamer Maldito makes us wish we understood Spanish!
https://youtu.be/bN1blyjdB2s

Let's Play: Andy Cowley, the voice of Garroth in Minecraft Diaries, checks out Albert & Otto
https://youtu.be/odz-7Eir3x8

Let's Play: Akwartz plays for the pleasure of the French-speaking crowd!
https://youtu.be/Unsgkbmoe0o

[url=http://www.greenlightgames.co.uk/the-saturday-review-albert-otto/][img=http://www.greenlightgames.co.uk/wp-content/themes/Greenlight/img/logo.svg][/img]83 out of 100[/url]

[quote=Greenlight Games]
Albert & Otto: The Adventure Begins is an exciting game. The puzzles stick to similar ideas but reuse them in ways that not only keep you on your toes, but also keeps things fresh. The game has a very good look, and does a good job following its inspiration of Tim Burton.[/quote]

[url=http://kbmod.com/2015/11/review-albert-and-otto-the-adventure-beings/][img=http://kbmod.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/12/kbmod-new3.png][/img]Recommended[/url]

[quote=KBMOD]At anywhere from 2 to 3 hours of game play, the intriguing puzzles and challenging platforming sections have me waiting with anticipation. I cant wait to see where developer K Bros Games takes us next on this journey of Albert and his red floppy rabbit Otto.[/quote]

If you'd like to review, stream, or record Albert & Otto, hit us up at codes@albertandotto.com ! And make sure to follow us on Twitter for all the latest development news -- [url=https://twitter.com/albertandotto]@AlbertAndOtto[/url].

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update
notes.notes:
STORY UPDATE  v1.3

I am very excited about this update, I've been looking forward to adding this extra content to the game for a while and it's finally here.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/letterbox.png[/img]

[h1]Postboxes [/h1]

In addition to collecting the shard pieces and unlocking the clue to Albert's past the player will now encounter mailboxes scattered throughout the game, in them he will find letters from his sister, each one has a drawing that reveals a little more about his sister and the events that transpired.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/letter.png[/img]

If you have already completed this episode and are interested in learning more about the story, it would be worth your while to jump back in for seconds. :)

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/artassets.png[/img]

I have also included a few more background assets that will hopefully offer up further clues.

[h1]Next Update [/h1]

Next week there will be more exciting stuff, I will be adding Steam achievements and support for a wider range of controllers.

As always thank you for your support.
Nik

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATE v1.2[/h1]

Another week another update. This time I have added a couple of features and a bit of story content. All your constructive reviews/comments are key to making A&O a better game so thank you for all your input.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[olist]
    [*]Added a shattered picture frame which the player must fill in by collecting shards scattered throughout the game. Collecting all 25 of them will reveal a big clue to Albert's past. 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/Frame_SteamUpdate.png[/img]

    [*]Added in-game menu which includes options for the following:
[list]
    [*]music volume slider
    [*]sfx volume slider
    [*]Vsync toggle on/off
    [*]Resolution Settings
    [*]Quality settings
    [*]Levitation sensitivity slider (for controller)
[/list]

 [*]Added mouse support in menus

 [*]Added a death counter at the end of the game that will show player how many times he has died and how. Share your screenshot on twitter and tag @albertandotto I really look forward to seeing your stats :) 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/Deaths_SteamPage.png[/img]

[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed rare animation glitch that caused final boss to turn head wrong way
- Fixed rare glitch that made Albert slide on the floating tree log. 
- Fixed minor bugs and glitches

As always, thank you for supporting Albert & Otto

notes.title: Review Round-Up
notes.notes:
Albert & Otto is making its way through the press, and we've rounded up some of our reviews! Come read what the press is saying about us.

- [url=http://www.geekyhobbies.com/albert-and-otto-the-adventure-begins-indie-game-review/]Geeky Hobbies: 4 out of 5[/url]

[quote=Geeky Hobbies]
The puzzle design is where Albert and Otto really stands out. The game only has a few different mechanics but the game does such a good job utilizing them in order to make some interesting puzzles. While I wish the game had more mechanics, the game does a good job mixing up how you use them so it doesn’t feel like you are doing the same things over and over again.[/quote]

- [url=http://www.modvive.com/2015/11/05/albert-and-otto-review-difficult-yet-cathartic/]Modvive: 98% EXTRAORDINARY[/url]

[quote=Modvive]Albert and Otto is a stimulating thrill ride of difficult puzzles and stunning art. This is not a game meant for casual beginners, and like Super Meat Boy, is only for those who wish to enjoy a satisfying struggle.[/quote]

- [url=http://www.se7ensins.com/articles/albert-and-otto-the-game-limbo-fans-have-been-waiting-for.2652/]Se7enSins: "I would genuinely consider this to be a no-brainer purchase."[/url]

[quote=Se7enSins]Good 2D puzzle platformers are few and far between. K Bros Games has finally awakened the genre from its dormant state with their first game, Albert & Otto. [/quote]

- [url=http://justadventure.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3140]Just Adventure: B+[/url]

[quote=Just Adventure]Albert & Otto gets top marks for requiring players to utilize a wide arsenal of skills for both platforming and puzzles. In addition, the ambience of the game is perfectly realized through the minimalist design, and it would be easy to see a complex narrative develop from the story's simple beginning.[/quote]


And an interview with Wake & Game, if you dare to take a peek into what's brewing in developer Nik Kostic's head:

[url=http://wakeandgame.com/kbros-games-interview-the-game-studio-behind-albert-otto/]http://wakeandgame.com/kbros-games-interview-the-game-studio-behind-albert-otto/[/url]


Help us get the word out! Tweet at your favorite outlets and journalists to let them about a lost little bunny, and please leave us a Steam review. Everything counts!

- [url=http://www.se7ensins.com/articles/albert-and-otto-the-game-limbo-fans-have-been-waiting-for.2652/]Se7enSins: "I would genuinely consider this to be a no-brainer purchase."[/url]

[quote=Se7enSins]Good 2D puzzle platformers are few and far between. K Bros Games has finally awakened the genre from its dormant state with their first game, Albert & Otto. [/quote]

- [url=http://justadventure.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3140]Just Adventure: B+[/url]

[quote=Just Adventure]Albert & Otto gets top marks for requiring players to utilize a wide arsenal of skills for both platforming and puzzles. In addition, the ambience of the game is perfectly realized through the minimalist design, and it would be easy to see a complex narrative develop from the story's simple beginning.[/quote]


And an interview with Wake & Game, if you dare to take a peek into what's brewing in developer Nik Kostic's head:

[url=http://wakeandgame.com/kbros-games-interview-the-game-studio-behind-albert-otto/]http://wakeandgame.com/kbros-games-interview-the-game-studio-behind-albert-otto/[/url]


Help us get the word out! Tweet at your favorite outlets and journalists to let them about a lost little bunny, and please leave us a Steam review. Everything counts!

notes.title: *SUGGESTIONS and BUG REPORTS*
notes.notes:
Hey Guys

It has been awesome reading what you had to say this past week. Some of you had great ideas and took the time out of your day to post suggestions which is really cool. I have already started implementing some of them and they will be released as part of the next update in a couple of weeks.

In light of this I have opened up this thread to keep suggestions and bug reports in one place. 
Just pop them in here and ill address them one by one. 

Would love to hear more from you. It's just me working on this game so it's really cool to get input from a fresh perspective. A big reason behind me releasing Albert & Otto episodically was to get you guys involved in the creation process so definitely expect more community based stuff in the next few weeks. 

Stay Awesome
Nik

notes.title: Small Update: Performance Fix
notes.notes:
Hey Guys. 

A couple of you were experiencing issues with non-smooth game-play and hard to make jumps. Most of this can be attributed to the game being set to ULTRA graphic quality as its default setting in the launcher causing slightly older computers to lag. 

If you are experiencing such issues and your computer meets the minimum requirements please turn the settings down a notch or two in the game launcher and your experience should improve tenfold. (the latest update now selects the medium option by default)

Big thank you to the people who have reported bugs and suggestions for improvements, I am hard at work on an Update and will have a little extra content for you guys in a few weeks as well :) 

Nik

notes.title: The Search for Anna Begins -- Albert & Otto NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
It's time to unveil the secrets and pull back the veil of darkness. Because she is not the damsel in distress, and you are not the hero.

Albert & Otto, as the cool kids say, HAS DROPPED!

We're beyond excited to receive our first full review. [url=http://wakeandgame.com/albert-otto-first-impressions/]Wake & Game has graced us with a score of 9.5/10![/url]

[quote=Wake & Game]Albert & Otto is a title that achieves what it sets out to do on a profound level, this is done in the sense of the gaming experience, story and all other elements that come together such as music and the games programming which in the end result in a fantastic game that we highly recommend to everyone.[/quote]

But the road here is only beginning. Please share Albert & Otto with your friends, and leave us a Steam review. The future of Albert & Otto, and Nik's sanity, depends on you! 

And maybe some Episode Two news soon...? :)

notes.title: NINE DAYS TO RELEASE! The previews are rolling in!
notes.notes:
With only NINE DAYS until we begin the search for Anna, Nik has been working like a madman. Sleep and food and sunshine are of no consequence when the release of Albert & Otto looms on the horizon!

How can you possibly endure the remaining wait? Check out some of the buzz we've been getting:

[url=http://indiegames.com/2015/10/uncover_the_dark_truth_in_albe.html] - IndieGames.com:[/url] [i]"Combining a compelling plot and setting with what I consider to be a fantastic art style, Albert & Otto is promising to be one of my most anticipated titles so far this year."[/i]

[url=http://www.thegamerscene.com/pc/preview-albert-otto/] - The Gamer Scene:[/url] [i] "Albert & Otto is obviously a good, fun game that promises to be one of October’s biggest hits. The game is like a good film and a good game tied into one. It is definitely something to look forward to, and puts K Bros Games on the list of rising indie game companies you should keep an eye on. The end of the month cannot get here fast enough."[/i]

[url=http://www.thatvideogameblog.com/2015/10/04/preview-albert-otto-pc/] - That Video Game Blog:[/url] [i]"I was stumped on the very first [puzzle] for longer than I'm willing to admit."[/i]

Don't forget -- WE NEED YOUR HELP! Every single tweet or trailer share or reddit post or wishlist add means EVERYTHING to us. Please drop us a note if you do so we can thank you personally!

Again, our trailer link:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Jym8UpZthg
And lastly, review codes are coming THIS WEEK! If you're media, a YouTuber, streamer, a Steam curator, an indie game advocate, or just have a lot of awesome gamer friends, give us a shout at codes@albertandotto.com.

notes.title: The Adventure Begins - Episode One of Albert & Otto Releases OCTOBER 28th!
notes.notes:
Hey Albert & Otto fans!

After an amazing showing at PAX, we've been working like mad over here to get Albert & Otto in shape for release. We're so excited to officially announce OCTOBER 28TH as the date. That's 36 days.

And, of course, with a release date comes a new trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Jym8UpZthg


Another major announcement is that Albert & Otto will be released in four episodes. Each episode will release at $4.99 and can be played as stand-alone adventures, but together they reveal the twists and turns of Albert & Otto's journey. Each chapter introduces new powers and abilities, which open up the world in new ways and keeps the gameplay fresh.

The current plan is to release new episodes every few months, depending on how fast Nik can polish everything up.

Phew. Lots of work to do.

WE NEED YOUR HELP! As you know, we're a one-man-dev team (plus helpful loving brother who keeps the business side running), so any help would mean the world to us! Spread the word, link the trailer, post on reddit, tweet to your favorite streamers and press sites about this magical little bunny you've found.

And, if YOU'RE the streamer or journalist or know someone who would love Albert & Otto, get in touch with us at codes@albertandotto.com ! We're putting the final touches on a preview build as we speak and we would love you to show it off.

Questions? Comments? Fire away!
